notes: Each entry binds one figma-restored reference screen to a route plus the fixture data needed
to reproduce that screen's copy. crop.topPx removes the iOS StatusBar+NavBar and bottomPx the
TabBar+HomeIndicator, because the impl render has no system chrome (WeChat draws it natively).
Screens without an entry are NOT scored — never report them as passing.
NPC派发任务 refs 18634/18676/18736 and 经验值详情 refs 1948_14177/14211 are route-gap deferrals (no matching route exists yet).

mip-tasks fixtures use design-ahead optional fields (purpose/completionStandard/attachmentHint/attachment) absent from the backend contract; production pages degrade via wx:if until the API adds them.

Settings refs 1728_19083/1731_19189/1861_18278: 账号设置 renders on packages/member/privacy/index behind a figmaLayout fixture branch (production keeps 退出登录/账号注销 blocks pinned by account-closure tests). 1731_19189 is named 账号安全 but its body is a 用户使用协议 document -> user-agreement page, fixture-only placeholder copy. 1861_18278 隐私设置 has no route: in-page figmaPanel branch on privacy/index; 绑定手机/绑定微信/会员服务协议 rows and both toggles have no destination/backend yet.

Guest refs 1732_19323/2622_34610/2622_34365/2629_34819/2632_35120 嘉宾 render on packages/member/mip-received/index GUEST behind a figmaLayout fixture branch (production keeps 总浏览量 + tabs + list pinned by mip-received-interactions tests). Badge PNGs (heart-line/heart-fill/endorse/endorse-light/emblem-dark/emblem-crimson) are baked from the ref renders; heart/endorse/clover counts and the Lv.23/tag/intro/inviter card fields are design-ahead — the backend listReceived GUEST DTO has none of them yet, so they are fixture-only until the contract grows.
